messages.subject: shiny renderDataTable - translated
parts:
Hi

I want a DataTable to have headerInfo/search/etc titles in spanish.

I see there are some plugins available but I haven't been able to figure out how to use them, is it using options? callback?

https://datatables.net/plug-ins/i18n/


Any help appreciated!

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: shiny renderDataTable - translated
parts:
You can pass a URL to options = list(language = list(url = ???)) in
renderDataTable() in shiny. With the new DT package
(http://rstudio.github.io/DT/), you can pass this to datatable(). Here
are some examples:

http://rstudio.github.io/DT/004-i18n.html

More info on transition from shiny to DT for DataTables:
http://rstudio.github.io/DT/shiny.html

Regards,
Yihui
